extension.description: Neuradni VOYO.si vtičnik za Kodi. Prijava z obstoječim VOYO.si računom (s kodo na TV ali z e-pošto), brskanje po filmih, serijah in oddajah, Nadaljuj z ogledom in Moj VOYO. Predvajanje z zaščito Widevine DRM.
Unofficial VOYO.si Kodi video add-on. Log in with your VOYO.si account (TV code or e-mail), browse movies, series and shows, continue watching and My VOYO. Widevine DRM playback.
extension.disclaimer: Unofficial add-on, not affiliated with PRO PLUS d.o.o. A VOYO.si subscription is required.
Neuradni dodatek, ni povezan s PRO PLUS d.o.o. Potrebna je naročnina na VOYO.si.
extension.news:
v1.1.2 - Fix "visitor not set" login error: the main VOYO profile is now selected automatically after login (no profile menu) - You may need to log in once more after updating
v1.1.0 - Kodi is now registered as a single VOYO device that survives restarts (no more new device on every boot) - New login: pairing code for TV or e-mail/password dialog; sessions refresh silently - Logout can remove the device from the account to free a slot - My VOYO list, proper Continue watching with titles and resume - Featured rows from the voyo.si home page, search history - Redesigned settings, official VOYO logo, Kodi 20-22 compatibility fixes

extension.description: Uradno skladišče za namestitev in samodejne posodobitve dodatka VOYO.si za Kodi.
Repository for installing and updating VOYO.si Kodi video add-on.
